blueprints.title: BGE Embeddings + Reranker
blueprints.summary: BAAI General Embedding (sentence-transformers + bge-reranker). CPU-friendly multilingual embeddings + cross-encoder reranking. Default model bge-small-en-v1.5; bp-llm-gateway discovers via Service annotation.

blueprints.title: cert-manager
blueprints.summary: TLS certificate automation. Lets Encrypt issuer with Dynadot DNS-01 for omani.works pool, HTTP-01 for BYO domains.

blueprints.title: Cilium
blueprints.summary: Unified CNI + Service Mesh (eBPF). mTLS via WireGuard, Hubble observability, Gateway API.

blueprints.title: flux
blueprints.summary: GitOps reconciler. One per vcluster (source + kustomize + helm controllers); host-level Flux per host cluster watches its bp-* OCI sources.

blueprints.title: gitea
blueprints.summary: Gitea — per-Sovereign Git server. Catalyst control plane. Hosts catalog (public Blueprint mirror), catalog-sovereign (Sovereign-curated private Blueprints), one Gitea Org per Catalyst Organization, and system (sovereign-admin scope).

blueprints.title: Apache Guacamole
blueprints.summary: Clientless HTML5 remote-desktop gateway. Browser-based RDP / VNC / SSH and kubectl-exec into Pods, with Keycloak SSO and full session recording to SeaweedFS. One Guacamole per Sovereign per ADR-0001 §11.

blueprints.title: k8s-ws-proxy
blueprints.summary: Per-node WebSocket exec proxy that bridges HMAC-signed upstream callers (catalyst-api, Guacamole) onto the local kube-apiserver pods/exec stream. DaemonSet with internalTrafficPolicy=Local for node-local sessions.

blueprints.title: keycloak
blueprints.summary: Keycloak — user identity. Topology decided by Sovereign CRD spec.keycloakTopology (per-organization for Organizations, shared-sovereign for corporate).

blueprints.title: nats-jetstream
blueprints.summary: Event spine for the Catalyst control plane. JetStream Streams + KV + Object Store via bundled nack JetStream Controller (Wave 5.45

blueprints.title: NeMo Guardrails
blueprints.summary: Programmable AI safety firewall — blocks prompt injection, PII leaks, off-topic content, and hallucinated citations between user input and the LLM. Wraps NVIDIA's `nemoguardrails server` (FastAPI on port 8000) as a Deployment + Service. Inline filter for bp-llm-gateway and bp-vllm.

blueprints.title: NetBird
blueprints.summary: WireGuard-based zero-trust mesh + remote-access overlay. Operators / engineers / customer admins enroll devices via Keycloak SSO and reach Sovereign-internal services from any laptop. Includes management + signal + coturn (TURN/STUN). One NetBird per Sovereign per ADR-0001 §11.

blueprints.title: openbao
blueprints.summary: OpenBao secret backend. 3-node Raft per region (independent quorum, async perf-replication across regions). MPL 2.0 — drop-in Vault replacement.

blueprints.title: sealed-secrets
blueprints.summary: Sealed Secrets — used during Phase 0 bootstrap to transport bootstrap-only secrets, then archived after OpenBao + ESO replace it.

blueprints.title: spire
blueprints.summary: SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity. 5-min rotating SVIDs. Server on mgt cluster + agent per host cluster.

blueprints.title: Temporal
blueprints.summary: Durable workflow orchestration with saga + compensation. Postgres-backed (CNPG); Postgres visibility store; Web UI; Keycloak OIDC integration via `--auth-claim-mapper`.

blueprints.title: vLLM
blueprints.summary: High-throughput LLM inference engine with PagedAttention. OpenAI-compatible API. GPU-accelerated when nvidia.com/gpu is available; CPU fallback for non-GPU dev Sovereigns.
